summary: Run any model on RunComfy from the command line. The `runcomfy` CLI is one binary, one auth, hundreds of model endpoints — image generation, image edit, video generation, image-to-video, lip-sync, face swap, video edit, inpainting, outpainting, extend, ControlNet, relight, upscale, LoRA training…
whenToUse: Use when installing, signing in to or running the runcomfy CLI to call a RunComfy model endpoint, poll its status and download the output.
